command:
set -eu
umask 022
tmp_unit=/etc/systemd/system/.inventory-worker.service.new
printf '%s\n' \
  '[Unit]' \
  'Description=Inventory Worker' \
  'After=network.target' \
  '' \
  '[Service]' \
  'Type=simple' \
  'ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker' \
  'Restart=on-failure' \
  'RestartSec=5s' \
  '' \
  '[Install]' \
  'WantedBy=multi-user.target' > "$tmp_unit"
chmod 0644 "$tmp_unit"
mv "$tmp_unit" /etc/systemd/system/inventory-worker.service
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl enable --now inventory-worker.service
printf '%s\n' '--- installed unit ---'
systemctl cat inventory-worker.service
